test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14th December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **kept**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Keep + V1 + ing: **to continue doing something without stopping.
 
• In the given passage, the partridge continued to worry for several days. 
 
• Thus, the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1 is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Passage:__ ***His friend did not return even the next day, or the day after. For several days, the partridge **(1)** __**kept**__ worrying, and then gave up (2)________ of his friend's return.(3)_______ dusk, a hare came to the tree and (4)_________ an empty hole at the foot of the tree, (5)_________ shelter inside. Since the partridge had given up hope, he did not object to the hole being occupied by the hare.*
